jurisdiction_name: SIL LAKE DIST C (SILVER LAKE VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Sil Lake Dist C (Village of Silver Lake Village) has 521 registered voters, with 48.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 24.2%, a modest Republican lean of 3.6 percentage points.
